_comment: Unified Wood-side forage flow. ONE flow maintains a single active_cap across all Wood materials. Each new spawn rolls the drop_pool (engine::ecs::WeightedPool) to pick which material instantiates -- bark, clay, or pale lichen today. As new Wood materials ship, add them to drop_pool with appropriate weights and no other config changes are needed. The ItemDef.rarity field on each material is a UI label, not a spawn driver: spawn behavior is purely the pool weights here.

quality_lottery._comment: Single shared quality lottery across all Wood materials. Per-material quality skew was a prior design that conflated rarity-of-material with quality-roll-within-material. The cleaner model: rarity controls IF the material drops (pool weight), quality controls how good the drop is (this lottery). Both apply uniformly.
